site_program: PulseOx multicentre study, six UK maternity units
screening_population: asymptomatic newborns >34 weeks gestation undergoing routine predischarge pulse-ox screening
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal pulse oximetry with repeat testing for borderline abnormality; persistent protocol abnormality or immediate severe desaturation = final positive
study_target_definition_raw: source critical CHD definition/list is the Ewer definition later adopted by the Cochrane review: HLHS, PA/IVS, simple TGA and IAA unconditional; CoA, AS, PS, TOF, PA/VSD and TAPVC conditional on death/intervention within 28 days
diagnosis_categories_raw: source critical CHD; serious CHD; significant CHD; respiratory/infective disease requiring intervention; remaining false-positive screens without significant CHD or intercurrent illness requiring treatment
diagnosis_counts_raw: 195 final positives; major CHD26 = critical18 + serious8; among source false positives169 = significant CHD6 + respiratory/infective disorders requiring intervention40 + residual true false positives123
individual_diagnoses: critical true-positive lesions: simple TGA x5; TAPVD x1; CoA+hypoplastic arch+VSD x1; PA+AVSD+TGA x1; HLHS x5; CoA x2; PA+double-inlet-LV x1; TGA+VSD x1; PA+VSD x1; plus serious CHD8 and significant CHD6
lesion_mapping_status: Seventeen of the 18 source-critical cases satisfy the locked target. The TGA+VSD case is complex rather than simple TGA and has no separate locked target component, so it re-enters the denominator. PA with AVSD/double-inlet-LV and PA+VSD are treated as PA with non-intact septum/PA-VSD-type anatomy; because the source critical classification itself requires death or intervention within 28 days, they satisfy the conditional target rule.
management_actionability_evidence: Respiratory/infective disorders40 explicitly required medical intervention -> CAN-A40. Significant CHD6 is defined by continuing monitoring after 6 months and/or drug treatment and was identified in the failed-screen pathway -> CAN-B6. Serious CHD8 requires intervention within the first year but participant-level screening-attributable management is not separable, and some major lesions had antenatal suspicion; the re-entered critical TGA+VSD case was also antenatally known. These 9 clinically relevant cardiac cases are conservatively CAN-U rather than Strict. The residual123 are explicitly reported as having neither significant CHD nor intercurrent illness requiring treatment -> aggregate NON_CAN123.
poolability_reason: exact protocol final-fail denominator; lesion-level target reconstruction; complete terminal clinical classification; well-baby/asymptomatic population; early timing retained as heterogeneity flag
source_full_text_provenance: Ewer AK et al. Lancet. 2011;378:785-794. PMID 21820732; DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(11)60753-8. Companion HTA report PMID 22284744 used for lesion/outcome detail only; no independent weight.
extraction_notes: Strict46/178; Expanded55/178; NON_CAN123. A provisional Block15 reading of Strict54/178 was rejected during QA because the eight source-serious CHD cases cannot all be assigned screening-attributable qualifying actionability; they remain CAN-U. R011/HTA is companion only.

screening_population: well-infant nursery population over eight years
screening_timing_raw: routine newborn screening/predischarge; exact distribution not recovered
screening_algorithm_raw: AAP/US CCHD pulse-ox screening program; failed screens received diagnostic evaluation
study_target_definition_raw: source CCHD classification follows a broader US program definition; lesion identities for the 12 source-CCHD positive screens are not available in the accessible primary material
diagnosis_categories_raw: source CCHD; non-CCHD diagnoses requiring further follow-up; noncardiac disorders
diagnosis_counts_raw: 31 failed screens, all with a disorder: source CCHD12; non-CCHD requiring further follow-up9; noncardiac conditions10
individual_diagnoses: individual lesions among source CCHD12 not recovered; nine non-CCHD follow-up diagnoses and ten noncardiac disorders reported at aggregate level
lesion_mapping_status: Without lesion identities the 12 source-CCHD cases cannot be removed as a harmonized block. From zero to all12 may qualify under the locked target, giving denominator19-31. Any source-CCHD case that re-enters the denominator is clinically relevant but cannot be assigned Strict from the accessible participant-level management evidence.
management_actionability_evidence: Nine non-CCHD cases explicitly required further follow-up -> CAN-B9. Ten noncardiac disorders are clinically relevant but no diagnosis-specific qualifying treatment/escalation/disposition consequence is recovered -> CAN-U10. If any of the 12 source-CCHD cases re-enter the harmonized-negative denominator they add to CAN-U, so CAN-U=10-22 and Expanded equals the admissible denominator19-31. Strict remains9.
poolability_reason: clinical classification is complete but source-CCHD lesions are unavailable, preventing a point harmonized denominator and single meta-analysis weight

screening_population: healthy term newborns; prenatal CHD and NICU admission before screening excluded
screening_algorithm_raw: newborn pulse-ox screening followed by pediatric cardiology/echocardiography after a positive screen
study_target_definition_raw: source CCHD14 among 18 CHD-positive screens; source definition broader than locked lesion/time mapping
diagnosis_categories_raw: source CCHD; noncritical CHD; normal echo
diagnosis_counts_raw: positive19; CHD18; source CCHD14 = TAPVD3, pulmonary atresia3, HLHS4, AV canal1, truncus1, TOF1, TGA1; noncritical CHD4 including ASD/PDA; normal echo1
individual_diagnoses: TAPVD x3; pulmonary atresia x3; HLHS x4; AV canal x1; truncus x1; TOF x1; TGA x1; noncritical CHD x4; normal echo x1
lesion_mapping_status: HLHS4 and standalone TGA1 are unconditional harmonized CCHD. Two TAPVD deaths and one pulmonary-atresia neonatal death satisfy the conditional/event rule, yielding at least8 harmonized CCHD. The third TAPVD lacks a qualifying <=28-day event. Two surviving pulmonary-atresia cases have unspecified septal anatomy and qualify only if PA/IVS. TOF lacks a qualifying event; AV canal and truncus are not automatic target lesions. Therefore harmonized CCHD=8-11 and denominator=8-11.
management_actionability_evidence: The 3-6 source-CCHD cases that re-enter the denominator are covered by the report's explicit care pathway of emergency surgery where indicated, follow-up to elective surgery, or palliative/comfort care; exact A/B subtype is not separable -> CAN-AB3-6. The four noncritical CHD cases are clinically relevant but no case-specific qualifying consequence is documented -> CAN-U4. The single normal echo has no noncardiac outcome ascertainment and remains UNKNOWN1.
poolability_reason: pulmonary-atresia anatomy and conditional-event mapping prevent a point denominator; ascertainment crosses the 90% threshold depending admissible mapping, so no principal weight is assigned
source_full_text_provenance: Gamhewage NC et al. Sri Lanka J Child Health. 2021;50(4):699-703. DOI 10.4038/sljch.v50i4.9890. Primary full-text PDF independently reverified; screenshot retrieval was attempted but failed with source cache error.
extraction_notes: Strict3-6; Expanded7-10; UNKNOWN1. Seven of the source-CCHD infants died in the neonatal period; lesion-specific death information supports the minimum target mapping without treating the source CCHD label as definitive.

screening_population: well newborns >36 weeks staying with mothers; NICU admission excluded
screening_timing_raw: predischarge newborn screening; exact age distribution not reported
screening_algorithm_raw: pulse oximetry with repeat testing; 14 persistent failures underwent clinical/echocardiographic evaluation
study_target_definition_raw: authors report nine CCCHD among eleven echocardiograms, but lesion labels require locked remapping
diagnosis_categories_raw: treated pulmonary conditions; minor cardiac findings; source CCCHD lesion group
diagnosis_counts_raw: persistent failures14: pulmonary disease requiring treatment3 (PPHN1, TTN1, congenital pneumonia+sepsis1); echo11 = PDA only1, VSD+small PDA1, remaining nine participants labeled CCCHD. Diagnostic labels for the nine are reported as TGA3, TAPVD2, TOF1, VSD+ASD+PFO with PH1, severe PH1, pulmonary stenosis2; label counts sum10 despite nine participants
individual_diagnoses: TGA3; TAPVD2; TOF1; VSD+ASD+PFO+PH1; severe PH1; pulmonary stenosis2; PDA1; VSD+small PDA1; PPHN1; TTN1; congenital pneumonia+sepsis1
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone TGA3 are definite harmonized CCHD and removed. Among the six remaining participants from the source nine-case CCCHD group, the reported TAPVD/TOF/pulmonary-stenosis labels are conditional without a documented <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization qualifier, while PH/septal-combination labels are not automatic target lesions. The source lesion-label count sums to10 for nine participants, so no participant-level lesion arithmetic is invented; however the participant class size after removing three TGA is exactly six.
management_actionability_evidence: Three pulmonary-condition infants explicitly required treatment -> CAN-A3. The six non-TGA participants in the source CCCHD group have clinically relevant diagnoses but lack participant-specific qualifying actionability evidence -> CAN-U6. PDA-only1 and VSD+small-PDA1 have no qualifying consequence -> NON_CAN2. Thus participant-level CAN-class arithmetic closes the denominator despite the overlapping/inconsistent lesion-label list.
poolability_reason: well-baby/NICU-excluded population, exact final-fail count, exact participant-level harmonized denominator and CAN-class totals, 100% ascertainment; source lesion-label inconsistency is retained but does not alter participant-class arithmetic
